# looker_model_set (Data Source)

Looks up a Looker model set by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "looker_model_set" "example" {
  name = "Marketing Models"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the model set. Matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `models` (Set of String)
